issues.description: Attribute type mismatch for field 'numberOfInscribedStudents': the problem statement UML declares numberOfInscribedStudents as int (problem_statement.md: line 65) and the UML also shows getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int (problem_statement.md: line 70). The solution implementation declares the field as long (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java: line 7) and provides a getter/setter using long, while its getTotalNumberOfStudents() method is declared to return int (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java: line 75) but sums a long and an int. This combination causes a type mismatch that will not compile (long + int produces a long which cannot be returned from a method declared to return int) and will confuse students about the intended type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfInscribedStudents consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution implementation field and its getter/setter to int (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java: change 'private long numberOfInscribedStudents;' to 'private int numberOfInscribedStudents;' and adjust related methods) so it matches the UML and preserves getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int. Alternatively, if large counts are required, update the UML and the getTotalNumberOfStudents() method signature to use long, and ensure all uses and tests are updated accordingly.
